slides.say: You read a promise with use, and Suspense shows the fallback again on every re-render. The promise is not cached.
A new promise created during render is a different promise each time. So React suspends again and again.
Cache it, so the same URL returns the same promise. On re-render, use reads the resolved value without suspending.

slides.text: Frameworks usually handle caching for you.
slides.say: Frameworks typically provide this caching. Without one, a simple module level cache works.
